text: No fire was detected on the asset during the evaluated period (23 September to 23 October 2026). The asset was monitored daily using NASA FIRMS data from four sensors: VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, and MODIS. Despite full coverage by all sensors throughout the period, no thermal anomalies or active fire detections intersected the asset's location.
